statements.statement: For every integer n >= 1, the number of ordinary ascent sequences avoiding both 000 and 011 is n.
For an endotree T of size n with in-order word x=alpha(T), T is a Fishburn tree if and only if x is a modified ascent sequence of size n.
Every finite basis containing only patterns (sigma,[|sigma|-1]) and (sigma,[|sigma|-2]) admits a finite enumeration scheme whose reversible deletion sets are empty or {1}.
An inversion sequence of length n has integer entries e_i with 0 <= e_i < i for 1 <= i <= n.
Traverse two rule universes to find parallel specifications, then reconstruct maps from matched constructors.
The extended abstract reports algebraic generating functions for inversion sequences avoiding 021 and any finite additional pattern set.
